name: morning-agent
description: 朝刊エージェント便 - 毎朝のブリーフィングメールを自動生成するLambda

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@aws-sdk/* --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent && cp src/config/topics.yaml dist/topics.yaml && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync(require.resolve('research-hub-mcp/config/feeds.json'),'dist/feeds.json')" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/site/static','dist/site',{recursive:true})"
scripts.test: npm run test:site-auth && npm run test:paper-token-guard && npm run test:paper-api && npm run test:paper-highlights && npm run test:paper-today-groups && npm run test:site-data && npm run test:feed-parse && npm run test:dedup && npm run test:topics && npm run test:huggingface
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd infra && npx cdk deploy --all
